description: Performs deep audit and entity extraction on EU freight and customs documents (CMR Consignment Notes, Tullverket SAD Customs Declarations, Commercial Invoices). Extracts TARIC/HS codes, gross/net weights, Incoterms, currency, and cross-checks for discrepancy risks.

documentText.description: Raw text content of the customs document, CMR note, or commercial invoice to audit.

documentType.description: Type of document. Options: 'CMR', 'SAD_DECLARATION', 'COMMERCIAL_INVOICE', 'AUTO_DETECT'. Defaults to 'AUTO_DETECT'.

name: datacastle_audit_customs_document
